card.name: Instruction wording at step or phrase starts
card.fires_on: Short linking or opening words in instructions: "as" in "or as directed", "Open" starting a numbered step, and a period ending a step. It also fires on "long", "with" and "taking" inside set phrases like "as long as" and "consistent with".

modes.label: As directed
modes.description: The word "as" after "or" in directions to use a product as directed by a physician.
modes.example: once or twice daily or<< as>> directed by a physician.

modes.label: Step openers
modes.description: A step verb like "Open" or the period closing a step in how-to instructions.

modes.label: Set phrases
modes.description: Words inside stock dosing phrases such as "as long as" or "consistent with".
modes.example: should continue as<< long>> as clinically indicated.

card.writes: It seems to favor words like "most suitable" and "appropriate" and to disfavor color and monthly words, but the effect is weak.
card.plain: It marks the small words in instruction phrases such as "or as directed" and at the start of a step.
